items.note: A.1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restored, and A.1.2 gives the three-stage composition (763). The method names the cancelling first and last rows, but the key computation that the net change (JV+RG)x is the identity (central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side wires cancelling intersection one, lines 748-759) is missing, as are h=100, the triple indexing and the wire counts.

Frames D_v, edge change D_vD_u^{-1}, a common frame commuting with the pointwise linear gate by R-linearity, and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} all follow lines 804-817. The route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is only paraphrased in A.2.4.

The plan states comparable nondegenerate labels from triple indicators, the only decreasing edges (center, time 3 to 4, loss h), L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and both ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation stops at the lemma's statements. It leaves out the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines (t_X ⊥ t_Y, the reason edges nest), the gate-label table and residual table, and the source/sink sums N and Wm-N behind the telescoping.

A.3.4 gives endpoint difference I_m on every role and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm, and B.2.2 gives the shear H<-H+D through Phi_M frames. 'With the projection matrices as frames' leaves out the essential negative source matrix -P_{U_a} on X_a (1117-1118, 1169-1170). The proof is absent: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N rank-one source exceptions.

The plan correctly gives one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, and C^{⊗m} on every role after corrections and undoing the exchange. Its derivation leaves out the orthogonal weight-additivity mod 4 (1232-1245), which turns the frame difference into a sum of odd-weight characters. The 27-coordinate C^{-1} analysis on X_a->Y_a is only gestured at as 'diagonal corrections'.

A.5 states that the deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, so tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} gives s/W<m^tau. A.3.3-A.3.4 give L/N<1/2 and the strict deficit. The exact eta values and the inequality chain via log m<20 (1331-1338) are not given, so the result is stated, not derived.

A0.1 restates the elementary-streams lemma. A0.2 derives the controlled shift by the paper's split-at-Q-a and reversed-merge argument (577-588). Multiplication by a fixed rational unit, which the triangular shears need for diagonal units, is neither stated nor derived, and the elementary operations themselves are not derived.

Factorization A=E_1ΠE_2, triangular maps by controlled shifts in descending order, and one interchange per one of Π via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j all match the paper. The elimination proof of the factorization (topmost row, rightmost pivot, 1375-1391), the choice of the prime q, and the conjugation order (E_2 on D, E_1^{-1} on H, add ΠD, undo) are missing.

Every essential step is present and quoted correctly: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_M frames giving Phi_{I_m} on every role, the three-step interchange from the shear, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum in both cases a<=1 and a>1, and the O(V) fixed-tape schedule.

The route follows the paper: high digits as a row field with R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, a base-m decomposition summing to O(Ve^tau), and binary padding with e=O(u). The plan omits the essential padding of rows to the multiple R'=W^k⌈R/W^k⌉ (1684-1690). Without it the power-width hypothesis (divisibility by W^k) is not met. It also omits the field-order bookkeeping that returns h^+ to its place.

The plan follows the paper: edge kernels per residual vector, residual directions moved to slots by a binary basis change, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^fZ^{⊗f}C^{⊗f}Z^{⊗f}, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The conjugation identity P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} is described in words rather than written out.

Eight conditional additions flipping u's parity and restoring w, one cyclic shift per line, the bad set with |B|<=delta_bad M, and the extract/radix-sort/reinsert repair all follow 2013-2195. The separate O(V) handling of the top position j_{f-1} is omitted, which is minor. The plan states the cost in its family form, O(V(L^tau+1)).

Node overhead, V/W children, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves below d^beta, and the final O(d^{lambda'}) bound are correct. The plan never says where the rows come from: the first q_0 chunks processed individually and used as a row index, padded to a multiple of W^{k_0} (2306-2323). The internal/leaf sums via K<=e^{c/beta} and a^j<=(e/u)^sigma are compressed into one sentence.

The plan gives the O(Vd^{lambda'}) cost, one final truncation with error <sqrt2·2^{-p} staying in the disk, Delta=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉=o(p) and A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, matching the paper's route. The statement leaves out K=⌊d^c⌋ and the exponent conditions on c, lambda, lambda'.

Contractions, character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, the DIF step with signed-shift twiddles, bit-reversed order B_t, the opposite procedure F^+B^{-1}, grouping into H followed by J_E, the layout L by prefix moves and width-K exchanges, the cost terms and the error sqrt2·l·2^{-p} all follow the paper.

Kronecker substitution at B_0=2^{4p}, the bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred-residue recovery with carry, and four integer products giving O(rp log(rp)) are the paper's steps. The negacyclic reduction is implicit.
Normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the retained LB order via P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the error 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta scaled by M, and M=T/r products all match 3414-3495.

F.1.2 and F.1.4 state the identities correctly. The F.1 headline drops P_s from the left side and omits the hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4. The method names HvdH's identity and the normalization to contractions, but the sub-steps only restate outputs. The construction (S, T, N=CTD, Neumann inverse, left inverse D N^{-1} C) is absent, and so is the axis-exposure cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

The plan covers the chirp identity, the period t_i, the coefficient check that squares cancel, F^+R=R^{-1}F^+ via substitution, R commuting with pointwise products, the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for RF^+. This is the paper's route.

The plan gives b, p=6b, d, T, t_i, r, the prime intervals, T/2<S<T, epsilon and kappa. It leaves out lambda, c, lambda', delta, eta=1/(4d), alpha and gamma, and the derivation is limited to the method sentence (prime-counting estimate) plus quoted conclusions.

The isomorphism, the triangular formula b_i, updates in order i=d,...,1 as controlled shifts, and O(d^2) axis moves costing O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) follow the paper. The exponents mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and prefix products P_i are used but never defined.

The plan covers well-definedness from (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal map, the wrap factor zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T. The computed twist error 4·2^{-p} is not mentioned.

The source transform (linewise A, chirp convolution, linewise B_0, scaling by 2^gamma, with exact counterpart RF_s), the conjugate opposite procedure, and the six-step algorithm with its two S scalings match the paper.

The error chain is the paper's route: E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28·2^gamma T^2L, final <448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, then carries <Q_0^2. The use of gamma<=b/4 is implicit.

Normalization by V=Tp, min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa from the chunk-exchange term (derived in G.8.3), log-power absorption, the final bound and the schoolbook cutoff are all correct. The other six normalized costs and their margins (table tab:costs, eq:margin-list) are not listed, so only one margin is actually derived.

No step explains why the bound refutes an eventual n lg n lower bound (liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0). Only S0's relies-on tag n-log-n-barrier and its motivation about Theta(n log n) scanning allude to the barrier. Conservatively absent.

errors.says: A Fourier transform of prime length s equals 2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA (with the coordinate permutations kept in the formula).
errors.paper: The identity is P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA: the permuted transform P_sF_s, not F_s, equals the right side, under gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4 (lines 3550-3562). F.1.2 states it correctly.

errors.says: With the projection matrices as frames, every input role sees endpoint difference I_m.
errors.paper: Gates and sinks get P_U, but source X_a gets the negative projection -P_{U_a} (and other sources zero). The frames are the address shears Phi_{M_v}, not the matrices. The endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m depends on that negative source matrix (lines 1115-1131, 1169-1170).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: rank-saving networks (A), then the two fast primitives (B interchange, C butterfly layer), synthetic transforms and ring convolution (D, E), resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (F), and assembly, precision and cost (G), ending in min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa and O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins at the base of the saving: the scalar network's cancellation computation, the orthogonality of neighbouring triples that makes labels nest, the rank-equals-dimension-change argument with the -P_{U_a} source exceptions, and the weight additivity for phase frames are asserted rather than shown. Further up, the row-padding step in arbitrary-width interchange and the origin of the rows in the butterfly recursion are missing.

steps.note: The plan states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored. It never gives h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples in T^3, N=C(h,3)^3 or m=h^3, so the defining quantities are missing.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs a change of frame. All of this is present.

Labels of dimension m are nondegenerate subspaces built from triple indicators, every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h. The ambient F^{⊗3} and the orthogonality of neighbours are not spelled out.

The plan uses the rank sum s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b and says an edge of rank a needs a interchanges. It never states that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, so an edge's cost is its dimension change, nor that the N source edges are rank-one exceptions (2P_{U_a}).
The plan gives sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b.
The plan gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s<Wm.

Endpoint difference I_m on every input role, and through the Phi_M frames the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows. The explicit sink(rho(w))-source(w) form appears only through f'_{rho(w)}=Phi_{I_m}f_w.
The plan gives A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, triangular parts in O(V), exactly one interchange per one, and s recursive calls in total.

The plan gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20·2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The bound log m<20 used to compare m^tau with m(1-eta) is not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs seven of nine steps of the central saving: frames, labels, the budget, the strict saving L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Two are only mentioned. The fixed network appears without h=100, N or m (C1). The link between rank and dimension change, with the N rank-one source exceptions that produce the -N term, is assumed rather than given (C4).
